# verda update

> Verda CLI **v1.10.0** · [other versions](https://github.com/verda-cloud/verda-cli/tags)

Update Verda CLI to the latest or a specific version

Update the Verda CLI binary in-place by downloading from GitHub Releases.
No Go installation required.

The binary is installed to ~/.verda/bin/ (no sudo required).

The downloaded archive is verified against the release's SHA256SUMS
before the running binary is replaced; on any verification failure
the update aborts and the binary is left untouched. Use --skip-verify
only as a deliberate escape hatch.

Without flags, updates to the latest version.
Use --target to install a specific version (upgrade or downgrade).
Use --list to show available versions.

**Usage**

```text
verda update [flags]
```

**Flags**

```text
      --list            List available versions
      --skip-verify     Skip checksum verification of the downloaded release archive (NOT recommended)
      --target string   Version to install (e.g. v1.0.0)
      --verify          Verify the binary checksum against the GitHub release
```

**Examples**

```bash
# Update to latest
verda update

# Install specific version
verda update --target v1.0.0

# List available versions
verda update --list
```

---

Global flags such as `--output`, `--agent` and `--debug` work with every command: see [Global Flags](../commands.md#global-flags).
